# NEW 2026-11-22 v16.5 Module 16.5-C: Colonial Independence Contagion & Gunpowder Empires Modernization Crisis (oe_dec_, 0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v165_finance_twilight.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope. Initialize bounded country state variables for Decolonization & Gunpowder Modernization.
oe_dec_init_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dec_modernization_score } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_dec_modernization_score value = 20 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dec_events_fired } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_dec_events_fired value = 0 }
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_dec_on value = 1 }
}

# Country scope. Adjust Gunpowder Empire modernization progress clamped to [0, 100].
oe_dec_add_modernization = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dec_modernization_score } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_dec_modernization_score value = 20 }
	}
	change_variable = { name = oe_dec_modernization_score add = $amt$ }
	clamp_variable = { name = oe_dec_modernization_score min = 0 max = 100 }
}

# Any scope. Shift the 3 global situation gauges (reform, liberty wave, concert balance), clamped to [0, 100].
oe_dec_shift_global = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_dec_reform_score } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_dec_reform_score value = 30 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_dec_liberty_wave } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_dec_liberty_wave value = 35 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_dec_concert_balance } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_dec_concert_balance value = 35 }
	}
	change_global_variable = { name = oe_dec_reform_score add = $ref$ }
	change_global_variable = { name = oe_dec_liberty_wave add = $lib$ }
	change_global_variable = { name = oe_dec_concert_balance add = $con$ }
	clamp_global_variable = { name = oe_dec_reform_score min = 0 max = 100 }
	clamp_global_variable = { name = oe_dec_liberty_wave min = 0 max = 100 }
	clamp_global_variable = { name = oe_dec_concert_balance min = 0 max = 100 }
}

# Any scope. Colonial Independence Contagion wave: spikes liberty desire across colonial subjects globally!
oe_dec_spread_liberty_contagion = {
	every_colonial_country = {
		limit = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_subject = yes
		}
		add_liberty_desire = 12
	}
}

# Any scope. Situation on_start handler for oe_sit_twilight_of_empires.
oe_dec_sit_on_start = {
	every_colonial_overlord = {
		limit = { is_rebel_country = no }
		oe_dec_init_country = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dec_ev_1 } }
			set_variable = { name = oe_dec_ev_1 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_dec_ev_cd value = 1 months = 24 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dec.1
		}
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = { oe_dec_is_gunpowder_empire = yes }
		oe_dec_init_country = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dec_ev_13 } }
			set_variable = { name = oe_dec_ev_13 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_dec_ev_cd value = 1 months = 24 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dec.13
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Biannual tug-of-war sync during oe_sit_twilight_of_empires (months 1 & 7).
oe_dec_sit_biannual_sync = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_dec_reform_score } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_dec_reform_score value = 30 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_dec_liberty_wave } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_dec_liberty_wave value = 35 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_dec_concert_balance } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_dec_concert_balance value = 35 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { any_colonial_country = { is_disloyal_subject = yes } }
		change_global_variable = { name = oe_dec_liberty_wave add = 4 }
	}
	else = {
		change_global_variable = { name = oe_dec_concert_balance add = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = { country_exists = c:TUR c:TUR = { has_country_modifier = oe_dec_mod_tanzimat_edict } }
				AND = { country_exists = c:MCH c:MCH = { has_country_modifier = oe_dec_mod_steam_arsenal } }
				AND = { country_exists = c:IRA c:IRA = { has_country_modifier = oe_dec_mod_foreign_instructors } }
				AND = { country_exists = c:MUG c:MUG = { has_country_modifier = oe_dec_mod_foreign_instructors } }
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = oe_dec_reform_score add = 4 }
	}
	clamp_global_variable = { name = oe_dec_reform_score min = 0 max = 100 }
	clamp_global_variable = { name = oe_dec_liberty_wave min = 0 max = 100 }
	clamp_global_variable = { name = oe_dec_concert_balance min = 0 max = 100 }
}

# Any scope. Situation Outcome 1 handler: Reformist Imperial Survival.
oe_dec_sit_resolve_reform = {
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			OR = {
				oe_dec_is_gunpowder_empire = yes
				is_colonial_overlord = yes
				is_great_power = yes
			}
		}
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dec_mod_outcome_reform_survival years = 30 mode = replace }
	}
}

# Any scope. Situation Outcome 2 handler: Wave of Sovereign Republics.
oe_dec_sit_resolve_republics = {
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			OR = {
				is_colonial_subject = yes
				is_colonial_overlord = yes
				is_great_power = yes
			}
		}
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dec_mod_outcome_sovereign_republics years = 30 mode = replace }
	}
}

# Any scope. Situation Outcome 3 handler: Multipolar Concert Settlement.
oe_dec_sit_resolve_concert = {
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			OR = {
				oe_dec_is_gunpowder_empire = yes
				is_colonial_overlord = yes
				is_great_power = yes
				is_ai = no
			}
		}
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dec_mod_outcome_concert_settlement years = 30 mode = replace }
	}
}

# Country scope. Yearly Colonial Independence Contagion dispatcher (oe_dec.1 - oe_dec.12, 1770-1836).
oe_dec_colonial_yearly = {
	oe_dec_init_country = yes
	if = {
		limit = { oe_main_mod_global_event_allowed = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_dec_ev_cd } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dec_ev_1 } current_year >= 1770 current_year <= 1825 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_dec_ev_1 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_dec_ev_cd value = 1 months = 24 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dec.1
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dec_ev_2 } current_year >= 1774 current_year <= 1828 }

			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dec.8
		}
		else_if = {

# Country scope. Yearly Gunpowder Empires Twilight & Modernization dispatcher (oe_dec.13 - oe_dec.26, 1730-1836).
oe_dec_gunpowder_yearly = {
	oe_dec_init_country = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dec_ev_cd } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dec_ev_13 } current_year >= 1730 current_year <= 1795 }

# Any scope. Exported zero-slot yearly dispatcher hook for oe_global_kernel_effects.txt.
# Zero cost prior to 1730; strictly O(1) tag dispatches for Gunpowder Empires + colonial iterators from 1770+.
oe_dec_kernel_yearly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			current_year >= 1730
			NOT = { global_var:oe_dec_ran_y ?= current_year }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_dec_ran_y value = current_year }

		# Gunpowder Empires Twilight & Modernization (1730-1836, verified valid tags only!)
		if = { limit = { country_exists = c:TUR c:TUR = { is_rebel_country = no } } c:TUR = { oe_dec_gunpowder_yearly = yes } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = c:IRA c:IRA = { is_rebel_country = no } } c:IRA = { oe_dec_gunpowder_yearly = yes } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = c:MUG c:MUG = { is_rebel_country = no } } c:MUG = { oe_dec_gunpowder_yearly = yes } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = c:DLH c:DLH = { is_rebel_country = no } } c:DLH = { oe_dec_gunpowder_yearly = yes } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = c:MCH c:MCH = { is_rebel_country = no } } c:MCH = { oe_dec_gunpowder_yearly = yes } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { is_rebel_country = no } } c:CHI = { oe_dec_gunpowder_yearly = yes } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = c:MNG c:MNG = { is_rebel_country = no } } c:MNG = { oe_dec_gunpowder_yearly = yes } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = c:MAM c:MAM = { is_rebel_country = no } } c:MAM = { oe_dec_gunpowder_yearly = yes } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = c:EGY c:EGY = { is_rebel_country = no } } c:EGY = { oe_dec_gunpowder_yearly = yes } }

		# Colonial Independence Contagion Wave (1770-1836)
		if = {
			limit = { current_year >= 1770 }
			every_colonial_overlord = {
				limit = { is_rebel_country = no }
				oe_dec_colonial_yearly = yes
			}
			every_colonial_country = {
				limit = { is_rebel_country = no }
				oe_dec_colonial_yearly = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
